$: Discard a loot card:
Choose one-
•Copy a non-trinket, non-ambush loot
being played by another player that
hasn't already been copied this turn.
------------------------------
•Put a monster not being
attacked into discard.
------------------------------
•Prevent the next 1 damage you
would take this turn.
------------------------------
-Eternal-
metadata.notes:
Crossover with the video game Gish.

These cards are part of the Edmund Booster Pack in The Summer of Isaac, released in June, 2024.

metadata.text:
Rewards from non-boss monsters
are doubled on your turn.
------------------------------
↷: If it's your turn, put a monster
not being attacked on the
bottom of the monster deck.
------------------------------
↷: Cancel the ↷ or $ ability of an
item or a loot being played. This
loses all abilities except eternal
until the next time your turn ends.
------------------------------
-Eternal-
metadata.notes:

At the start of your
turn, roll-

from this.
------------------------------

------------------------------
5-6: Put a AT counter on this.
------------------------------
